children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retrace into a range of 4,167-4,460 ringgit per metric ton in the fourth quarter, before rising toward the resistance at 4,933 ringgit again.
A projection analysis on a wave C from 3,696 ringgit reveals a key barrier, the 61.8% level. This wave may either end around this resistance or extend to 5,699 ringgit.
Regardless of the endpoints, a decent correction has started, which might be the same degree as the one from the October high of 4,612 ringgit.

A rising channel points at the target range formed by the 23.6% and the 38.2% levels. Strategically, the range would be confirmed when the market breaks the support at 4,697 ringgit, as a very shallow correction may stop around this level as well.
Generally, in an ABC corrective wave cycle, wave C may be equal to or longer than wave A. Based on this observation, the uptrend may resume upon the completion of the correction.

A break above 4,933 ringgit would confirm the continuation of the uptrend toward 5,699 ringgit. On the daily chart, a small triple-top formed around a resistance at 5,017 ringgit, the 123.6% projection level of an uptrend from 3,894 ringgit.

The pattern indicates a target of 4,588 ringgit, which will be confirmed when the market breaks a support at 4,679 ringgit. A few tops formed around this level in May and June, making this barrier exceptionally strong.

A pullback toward 4,803 ringgit may occur around the 4,679 ringgit, to be followed by a continuation of the drop toward 4,348-4,455 ringgit range, which is more fine-tuned than the target zone on the weekly chart.
